verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a Segment-alternative CDP and event pipeline, so an AI-built audience segment is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no audience or segment builder, natural-language or otherwise. Its MCP server lets external agents manage destinations, streams, Live Events and Functions, and Profile Builder creates profile records, but neither is an AI feature that turns a natural-language description into a reviewable segment definition grounded in the schema.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can describe an audience in natural language and AI builds the segment definition for review, grounded in my actual schema
